hints.title: Grid Remainder State Space
hints.text: For each cell (r, c), track the number of paths reaching it with a running path sum congruent to rem modulo k.

hints.title: Cell Transition Formula
hints.text: From top neighbor (r - 1, c) and left neighbor (r, c - 1), transition remainder rem to (rem + grid[r][c]) % k.

hints.title: Modulo Summation
hints.text: Sum paths from valid incoming directions modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Grid Modular Path Dynamic Programming Implementation

complexity.notes: Each cell updates k remainder states from its top and left neighbors.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all paths via DFS encounters exponential O(2^(m+n)) states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP table bounds state space to m * n * k integer entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that grid paths with modular divisibility require tracking remainders in DP state.
